description: This Java file defines an Android Activity class 'Intents' that provides methods to launch intent pickers for media selection (music, images, streams). It sets up UI interactions and handles intent creation for choosing media content.

classes.name: Intents
classes.description: An Android Activity providing UI for selecting media content via implicit intents.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view.

methods.name: onGetMusic
methods.description: Creates and launches an intent to select music files.

methods.name: onGetImage
methods.description: Creates and launches an intent to select image files.

methods.name: onGetStream
methods.description: Creates and launches an intent to select any type of file stream.
